item.title: Investigating microstructural anisotropy and productivity in high-power PBF-LB/M of Inconel 718 using dual-spot beam shaping strategy
item.description: This collaborative study investigates how a dual-spot beam shaping strategy affects microstructural anisotropy and build-rate productivity in high-power laser powder bed fusion of Inconel 718.
